source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole board (board_source.py / board.json rule)
activation_note: INERT until LAS-160 approves a reservation program. Links render plain with first-party UTM (utm_campaign=EXP-0103); no affiliate id is applied while every network in affiliate_config.json is disabled with a placeholder id. Flipping a network enabled=true with a real id there (or via its env var) activates the affiliate wrap on this rail with no code change. Caveat: an Eventbrite listing that already carries its own aff= search tag will not be overridden by our Eventbrite id (affiliate._add_params never clobbers an existing param); resolving that is an LAS-160 activation decision.
methodology: A window is listed only when its own crawl-captured link (booking_url, else source_url) lands on a recognised reservation/ticket platform, the crawl verified it (not needs_confirm), and it carries a real parseable close date that has not passed. No dead or invented links; an empty week is honest. Sorted soonest-closing first.

items.title: 100 Cities Project: Nashville Dinner Benefiting The Water Project
items.blurb: A charity dinner where the ticket supports The Water Project. Several additional dates are listed, and sales are flagged as ending soon.

items.title: Foodies + New Friends: Giving Back Edition
items.blurb: A group dinner with strangers who like to eat, billed as a giving back edition. The listing hints this run is ending soon, and sales are closing.

items.title: Joe Wagner Wine Dinner
items.blurb: Five courses, including braised short rib and Angus hanger steak, with six Joe Wagner wines poured alongside. One night only, ages 21+, and all sales are final.

items.title: Nashville Creators & Treasures Pop-Up
items.blurb: Three days of local makers, with handmade arts and crafts, jewelry, home decor, boutique fashion, gifts and specialty foods. It runs 10 AM to 9 PM, and Sunday is the last day.

items.title: Edible Nashville Fall Farm Dinner
items.blurb: Dinner on a farm outside downtown, with cocktails, wine and beer included. Andrew Rodriguez of Blue Aster cooks beef schnitzel and squash panna cotta, and The Gubernaughts play. No refunds.

items.title: Wagyu, Whiskey, and Wine
items.blurb: A steakhouse pairing night built around wagyu, whiskey and wine. One more date is offered, and sales are marked as ending soon.

items.title: Boozy Sundae Decorating Class
items.blurb: A Sunday afternoon class where you build your own spiked sundae. Six other dates are listed if the first is full.

items.title: A Fall Reset with Skin Pharm, Gus Mayer, Mama Mahjong & Merry-Go-Mahjong
items.blurb: A Monday evening collaboration between a skincare shop, a retailer and two mahjong outfits. Four brands share one room for a single night.

items.title: D'Andrews Bakery & Cocorico Collaboration Dinner
items.blurb: A one-night dinner pairing a local bakery with Cocorico in the kitchen. Just added to the listings, so seats are likely still open.

items.title: A Canvas Classic Christmas
items.blurb: An early Christmas-themed afternoon event at a skin studio, one day only.

items.title: Gather for Good: Nashville Dinner Benefit for Dreams and Wishes of TN
items.blurb: A charity dinner supporting Dreams and Wishes of TN, with a baker's dozen of other dates on the calendar if this one does not fit.

items.title: Backstage at Fairlane Hotel
items.blurb: A Friday evening event at the Fairlane Hotel. The listing gives no further detail, so check the page before planning around it.

items.title: Blue Material Comedy Show
items.blurb: A single-night comedy show with the adult material right in the name. Tickets start at $8.24, and a 2 for 1 deal is listed.

items.title: Mott Cha Market | November 2026
items.blurb: The November edition of a market held at Mott Cha, starting at noon on a Saturday.

items.title: SpaLiday Preview Party
items.blurb: A holiday spa preview party in Murfreesboro with three time slots listed on the page.

items.title: Handmade Pasta Making Class with Chef Taylor
items.venue: Mary Louise's Social Club at Tempo by Hilton Nashville Downtown
items.blurb: A hands-on pasta class led by Chef Taylor inside a downtown hotel social club. One extra date is listed if Friday is taken.

items.title: Nonna Notti Wine Dinner
items.blurb: A one-night wine dinner at an Italian market and deli, where the pairings come from the shelves around you.

items.title: The Signed Edition Book Fair Nashville
items.blurb: A one-day book fair built around signed editions, held at a downtown hotel. Tickets start at $0.00, with a 5% off select tickets offer and a 2 for 1 deal listed.

items.title: Tipsy Turkey Pub Crawl
items.blurb: A Thanksgiving-week pub crawl that starts mid-afternoon in Printers Alley, which gives you a head start on the turkey.

items.title: The Pasta Club: Gnocchi Night
items.blurb: A single-evening session devoted to gnocchi, held at a hotel and starting in the late afternoon.

items.title: AZAZIE Nashville Pop-up
items.blurb: Try on 50+ wedding dress styles and 100+ bridesmaid styles, and take your pick home the same day. General admission is free with 15% off in-store; early access at 9 AM is $40 and includes a private fitting room.
